Create src/components/chat-interface.tsx. Import: useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback, KeyboardEvent from 'react'; cn from '@/lib/utils'; CHAT_MODES, ChatMessage, ChatMode, convertScript, sendChatMessage from '@/lib/chat-service'; ScrollArea from '@/components/ui/scroll-area'; Select/SelectTrigger/SelectContent/SelectItem/SelectValue from '@/components/ui/select'; Textarea from '@/components/ui/textarea'; Button from '@/components/ui/button'. State: activeModeId:string (init CHAT_MODES[0]!.id), messages:ChatMessage[] (init []), inputText:string (init ''), isLoading:boolean (init false), error:string|null (init null). Refs: abortRef:MutableRefObject (init null), bottomRef:MutableRefObject (init null). Derive active mode: const mode = CHAT_MODES.find(m=>m.id===activeModeId) ?? CHAT_MODES[0]!. Auto-scroll effect: useEffect(() => { bottomRef.current?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'}) }, [messages]). handleSubmit: (1) trim+guard empty; (2) abort previous request; (3) create new AbortController; (4) setIsLoading(true), setError(null); (5) build userMessage with role:'user', text:inputText, displayText:inputText (will be replaced), fontClass:mode.fontClass, id:crypto.randomUUID(), timestamp:Date.now(); (6) setInputText(''); (7) try: userDisplay = await convertScript(inputText, mode.aksharaSource, mode.aksharaTarget, ctrl.signal); update userMessage.displayText; append to messages; reply = await sendChatMessage(inputText, mode, messages, ctrl.signal); replyDisplay = await convertScript(reply, mode.aksharaSource, mode.aksharaTarget, ctrl.signal); create assistantMessage; append to messages; catch: if err is AbortError skip, else setError(err.message); finally: setIsLoading(false). Note on state update pattern: since setMessages in sequence would capture stale state, use functional updates: setMessages(prev=>[...prev, userMsg]) then setMessages(prev=>[...prev, assistantMsg]). handleKeyDown: on Enter without Shift, call handleSubmit and preventDefault. findings: All 4 steps implemented. (1) Chat CSS appended to styles.css: @font-face for RanjanaUnicode from jsdelivr CDN with font-display:swap, third :root block with 8 --chat-* vars, all required classes (.chat-page, .chat-mode-row, .chat-mode-label, .chat-mode-select, .chat-messages, .chat-message, .chat-message--user/--assistant, .chat-message__bubble with BEM user/assistant variants, .chat-message__time, .chat-font--devanagari/--ranjana, .chat-status, .chat-error, .chat-input-row, .chat-input, .chat-send-btn), responsive @media (max-width:640px). (2) __root.tsx: added Noto Sans Newa + Noto Serif Tibetan Google Fonts link after existing EB Garamond link. (3) lipiAI-shell.tsx: Chat nav link inserted between About and logo-mark. (4) chat-interface.tsx: named export ChatInterface + default export; uses useState/useRef/useEffect/useCallback; CHAT_MODES[0]!.id init; functional setMessages updates; AbortController flow; convertScript + sendChatMessage calls; handles AbortError separately; Button onClick uses void handleSubmit().
